runs.command: for e in chromium firefox webkit; do python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open('research/release-1.4/screenshots/'+sys.argv[1]+'-results.json'));assert all(r['ok'] for r in d['results']) and not d['pageErrors'], sys.argv[1];print(sys.argv[1],'ok')" $e || exit 1; done
